sources.title: Qwen-Image Edit 2509 — Image AI Model by Qwen | Layer
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image Edit 2509 is an advanced iteration of the Qwen team's powerful image editing model. It builds upon the core capabilities of its predecessor, offering enhanced performance and precision for text-guided image manipulation. This version is ideal for AI artists and designers seeking the latest improvements in instruction-based editing for tasks like fine-grained object modification ...

sources.snippet: This September, we are pleased to introduce Qwen-Image-Edit-2509, the monthly iteration of Qwen-Image-Edit. To experience the latest model, please visit [Qwen Chat] (https://qwen.ai) and select the "Image Editing" feature.

sources.title: Qwen Image Edit 2509 by Alibaba: AI Image Editing Model | Lumenfall
sources.snippet: Qwen Image Edit 2509 is a specialized vision-language model developed by Alibaba designed for instruction-based image manipulation. Unlike standard text-to-image generators, this model accepts both an initial image and a natural language prompt to perform targeted modifications and transformations.
